test_name: Verify Login Page Accessibility and OAuth Login Options
description: This test validates the accessibility and functionality of the login page, ensuring OAuth login options (Google, GitHub, Azure, Okta, Auth0, PingFederate) are functional and accessible.
steps: Verify the presence of the main brand logo link using its selector.
Locate the OAuth login options for Google, GitHub, Azure, Okta, Auth0, and PingFederate using their respective selectors.
Click on the Google login button and verify the redirected URL.
Click on the GitHub login button and verify the redirected URL.
Repeat the same steps for Azure, Okta, Auth0, and PingFederate login buttons.
Verify that all links are enabled and accessible.
Validate that clicking each OAuth login button redirects the user correctly to the corresponding authentication provider's page.
expected_results: All OAuth login options are visible on the login page.
All links are enabled and clickable.
Clicking each link redirects to the correct authentication provider's page.
The main brand logo link is visible and functional.
edge_cases: OAuth login buttons are disabled or missing.
Redirect URLs are incorrect or unavailable.
Authentication provider pages throw errors during redirection.
The main brand logo is missing or not clickable.
Network disruptions prevent loading authentication provider pages.
data_requirements: Correct client IDs for all OAuth providers.
Redirect URIs configured correctly for all providers.
OAuth providers must be active and reachable.
Sample user accounts for testing authentication flows.
dependencies: Access to the login page on https://dev.roost.ai/login.
api_interactions: OAuth API calls to Google, GitHub, Azure, Okta, Auth0, and PingFederate.
Verify token responses from authentication providers.
performance_metrics: Page load time for the login page.
Redirection response time for each OAuth provider.
Click-to-response latency for each login button.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure all links have proper ARIA labels.
Verify color contrast ratios for all buttons and links.
Validate keyboard navigation support for all interactive elements.
